settings.a: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days (Monday–Friday). UK Standard Delivery takes 3–5 business days and is free on orders over £40 (otherwise £3.99). UK Express Delivery takes 1–2 business days (£6.99). You'll get tracking details by email once your order ships. See shipping & delivery.

settings.q: What if my jar arrives damaged?
settings.a: Email support@beeblend.co.uk within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and a photo, and we'll put it right quickly.

settings.q: Do you ship outside the UK?
settings.a: Yes. International delivery takes 7–14 business days, with shipping calculated at checkout. Customs duties and taxes are paid by the recipient.
We accept unopened, unused items within 14 days of delivery. See our returns & refunds policy.
